messages:
jess (support): Escalating a reproducible mid-stream disconnect for customer LiAM — they switch eSIM profile then toggle a VPN and the SSE stream dies mid-response. partial chunks delivered, no error, client sees EOF.
jess (support): Customer: liam, filing logs and repro below. Not a token expiry (token still valid for >5m).
liam (customer): repro steps: 1) start SSE stream to /v1/streams with Authorization header, 2) after ~4s flip eSIM profile in phone settings, 3) toggle system VPN on, 4) stream stops receiving further chunks, client logs: "read returned 0, connection closed by peer".
liam (customer): curl repro we ran: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=gpt-4o-mini"
```
liam (customer): observed output (truncated):
```
data: {"id":"tok_abc123","chunk":"Hello, this is par"

[data: partial chunk continues]

[then nothing, client shows socket close]
```
jess (support): attaching small tcpdump from client side (hex snippet): "TLS Application Data -> TLS Close Notify" then TCP FIN. Not a graceful HTTP 500 or 502.
nora (eng-runtime): @jess can you paste the request headers (redact key) + trace-id from the root request? want to correlate with gateway logs. also which gateway/proxy the customer is hitting (region)?
jess (support): trace-id: trace-9a7f3c, region: eu-west-1, headers: Accept: text/event-stream, Connection: keep-alive, Upgrade: (none), User-Agent: LLMClient/2.1
omar (eng-infra): preliminary thought — mobile network switching often causes client TCP teardown (FIN/RST) which looks identical to mid-stream disconnects. but we should rule out our idle or proxy timeouts and any token rotation code that might close socket on auth failure.
emma (eng-sre): I pulled proxy logs for trace-9a7f3c: upstream returned 200 and kept connection open for ~6.2s, then saw `client_closed_request` at proxy layer. No 4xx/5xx from origin. attaching relevant log lines: 
```
[proxy] 1777777777 trace-9a7f3c "GET /v1/streams" 200 1023 6.2s "client_closed_request"
```
nora (eng-runtime): good, that matches client FIN. Two angles: 1) client network is tearing down during eSIM/VPN switch -> nothing for us to do except recommend client-side retry/backoff and resumable stream support, 2) verify we aren't hitting a TCP keepalive/idle setting that aggressively closes a half-open socket during network migration.
jess (support): customer asks: is there a server-side setting we can change to reduce likelihood? they want best-practice for mobile apps.
omar (eng-infra): recommend these client-side mitigations: 1) detect SIGNET/NETCHANGE and re-establish stream with last-good-event-id (use Last-Event-ID SSE header or our chunk id semantics), 2) enable small client buffer + exponential backoff resume, 3) keep a short application-level heartbeat (send a noop every 15s). On server side we already honor Last-Event-Id and accept resume requests if model supports incremental resume.
nora (eng-runtime): we can add a server-side tweak temporarily to increase idle timeout for this customer pool to 120s (currently 30s) if they want less risk during handoffs. that will not help if client emits a FIN, but may help cases where NAT mapping times out and client silently drops. must be enabled per-tenant.
liam (customer): can you enable that for our tenant? We do a lot of in-field tests with SIM profile switching.
emma (eng-sre): enabled `stream_idle_timeout=120s` for tenant tidy-corp. also added tcp_keepalive tuning on the edge for their VIP. rolling out now, trace id for change: cfg-777-apply.
liam (customer): thanks. we'll test and report back. one more datapoint: when we run a proxy on the phone (local mitm proxy) the stream survives the eSIM flip but with a small pause. suggests client TCP stack is the culprit.
nora (eng-runtime): makes sense. please add client logs showing the precise sequence of socket ioctl/close events if you can. we can add more robust resumability later.
nora (eng-runtime): quick internal note: follow-up item to investigate server-side resume semantics for token-rotation + keepalive interplay — filed as eng-runtime ticket RT-1582.
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-45 (support: midstream disconnect during mobile network profile change).
jess (support): Next steps: 1) liam will test with increased idle timeout and report results, 2) liam to share any client pcap or syslog showing socket FIN/RST sequence, 3) eng-runtime (nora) to review RT-1582 for longer-term resumability and check for any auth-close codepaths. closing escalation if customer confirms resolved. :thumbsup:
